text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? That thing in the alley, is it a 
signboard?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I didn't know there was a variety 
store in a place like this. Quiet, with an 
antique scent... It's such a relaxing 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this pair of glasses... "A design 
unlike any other in the world"—that's just 
perfect for those two.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This is a book-shaped... photo frame, huh. 
Yeah, yeah, how the two of them met is 
just like a story, so looking back on it 
with this—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wait, haha! Here I go picking out gifts 
for my moms again.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There's no particular reason to give a 
gift, but whenever I spot something nice, 
I just can't help myself...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah! That fountain pen over there too――

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm, maybe the picture frame after all? 
Though the glass from the first shop was 
nice too...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oops, is it training time already? But—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Just for today, it shouldn't hurt, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"No gift could ever match the 
irreplaceable love I received from the two 
of them, but still."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why I want to give 
something straight from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, prioritizing picking out gifts for 
her parents, Mr. C.B. ended up neglecting 
her training.
